new.name: INTERPRETS_EVIDENCE_TO_IDENTIFY_TARGET
new.definition: The reasoning uses specific evidence supplied by an observation to single out a concrete repository object, location, or value as the target for further investigation or action.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text interpreting evidence and identifying a target.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The prior observation supplying the specific evidence used to identify the target.

assertion_conditions: The observation supplies specific evidence such as a commit hash, reflog entry, object identifier, file content, or search result.
The reasoning explicitly names or selects a specific target for subsequent inspection, recovery, or cleanup based on that evidence.
The evidentiary link is stated or clearly inferable from the reasoning's reference to the observation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates the task or gives a general plan without identifying a specific target.
The identified target is not grounded in the cited observation or the observation only provides incidental context.

new.name: PERSISTS_OBSERVED_VALUE_TO_OUTPUT
new.definition: An action writes a value reported by an observation into a durable output file or artifact, preserving the value outside its original source.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action creating or writing to a persistent output artifact.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the value that is to be preserved.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a specific value that the task treats as the target to recover or extract.
The action creates or writes to an output path, and the written content includes that observed value.
The action is not merely displaying, printing, or transmitting the value without creating a persistent output.
exclusion_conditions: The observation only supplies a search key, path, or context rather than the value being preserved.
The action reads, prints, or verifies stored content without writing a new output artifact.
The written content cannot be traced to the observation.

new.name: PERFORMS_EXHAUSTIVE_TARGET_SEARCH
new.definition: An action searches the full relevant repository object set or repository storage for occurrences of a target pattern, rather than inspecting only a known file, revision, or path.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action scanning the repository or object store for the target pattern.

assertion_conditions: The action enumerates all objects, all reachable revisions, or recursively scans repository storage for the target pattern.
The search scope is intended to establish presence or absence across the whole relevant repository, not just a single known location.
exclusion_conditions: The action inspects only a specific known commit, file, or directory.
A broad listing that does not search for the target pattern or enumerate the full object set does not qualify.

new.name: REPORTS_TARGET_PATTERN_MATCH
new.definition: An observation reports at least one occurrence of the sought target pattern or explicitly identifies a matching artifact in the searched scope.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting a target match or matching artifact.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains a value matching the target pattern or names a specific object or file as containing the target.
The match is presented as a finding from inspection or search.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports no matches, an error, or only unrelated content.
A generic listing or status output without an identified target match does not qualify.

new.name: REPORTS_TARGET_PATTERN_ABSENCE
new.definition: An observation explicitly reports that the sought target pattern or artifact is absent from the searched scope, such as negative search results or a clean integrity check for the removed artifact.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation explicitly reporting absence of the target.

assertion_conditions: The observation states that no occurrence of the target was found in repository storage or across all checked revisions.
The negative result is presented as covering the relevant search scope.
exclusion_conditions: The observation is silent about the target, reports only an unrelated error, or merely lists remaining unrelated objects.
A check covers only an unchecked subset or does not state an absence result.

new.name: ATTEMPTS_TO_ERADICATE_OBSERVED_ARTIFACT
new.definition: An action removes or prunes references and unreachable storage objects that were observed to retain an exposed artifact, attempting to make the artifact unrecoverable from the source repository or storage.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action attempting to remove or prune the observed artifact from storage.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The prior observation reporting that the artifact is present or retained.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports that the target artifact is present or retained through a repository reference, reflog, or unreachable object.
The action expires references and/or prunes unreachable objects so that the observed artifact's storage is targeted for deletion.
The action is directed at eliminating the artifact rather than merely inspecting or displaying it.
exclusion_conditions: The action only searches for, reads, or displays the artifact.
The action removes unrelated content without addressing the observed retained artifact.
The action writes a copy of the artifact to a recovery location but does not remove it from the source.

new.name: CONFIRMS_REMEDIATION_OF_ARTIFACT
new.definition: A cleanup action addresses an observed artifact exposure, and a subsequent verification observation establishes that the same artifact is no longer present in the relevant scope.

parameters.name: cleanup_action
parameters.description: The action attempting to remove or invalidate the observed artifact.

parameters.name: exposure_observation
parameters.description: The earlier observation reporting the artifact as present or retained.

parameters.name: verification_observation
parameters.description: The later observation confirming absence or a clean result for the same artifact.

assertion_conditions: The exposure observation precedes the cleanup action and reports the artifact as present or retained.
The cleanup action attempts to remove or invalidate the observed artifact's storage or access path.
The verification observation follows the cleanup action and reports absence, a clean integrity check, or no matches for the same artifact across the relevant scope.
exclusion_conditions: The cleanup is attempted without a subsequent verification observation.
The later observation does not check the same artifact or scope, or still reports a match.
The verification only examines an unrelated property.

new.name: CHECKS_PRESERVATION_AGAINST_BASELINE
new.definition: A verification action re-inspects files, commits, or metadata recorded in an earlier baseline observation, and a resulting verification observation shows that those unrelated items remain unchanged.

parameters.name: verification_action
parameters.description: The action re-checking the items after modification or remediation.

parameters.name: baseline_observation
parameters.description: The earlier observation recording concrete identifiers or content of unrelated items.

parameters.name: verification_observation
parameters.description: The later observation showing whether those unrelated items remain unchanged.

assertion_conditions: The baseline observation records concrete identifiers or content of unrelated files or commits before the remediation or modification.
The verification action re-checks those same items after the modification.
The verification observation reports matching identifiers or content, a clean status, or another concrete indication that the unrelated items were preserved.
exclusion_conditions: No baseline observation identifies the items being checked.
The verification action checks only removal of the target artifact.
The verification observation shows changed unrelated content or cannot be compared with the baseline.

new.name: CONCLUDES_TASK_REQUIREMENTS_SATISFIED
new.definition: The reasoning synthesizes verification evidence and explicitly concludes that all stated task requirements have been satisfied.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text concluding that task requirements are satisfied.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning refers to multiple task requirements, such as recovery, cleanup, and preservation, and states that each is satisfied.
The conclusion is tied to observed verification results rather than only to an intention or unverified claim.
exclusion_conditions: A summary that lists intended actions without claiming verified completion does not qualify.
A conclusion about only one requirement or a partial state does not qualify.
